description: Four frozen D1-D6 cases with Baseline, Tools, and Tools-RAG answers from the immutable full run; selected before J0/J1 calibration for score range, native/recovered completion, single-tool and multi-tool coverage.
selection_notes: Historical Judge scores were used only to create broad low, medium, and high strata; they are not expert ground truth.
All three systems are retained within every selected case so within-case rankings can be compared.
The calibration does not regenerate any 9B answer and does not overwrite the source run.
